diagnosis: In this y-websocket synchronization server, the HTTP upgrade handler extracts the collaborative document name docName directly from the URL path. Although it checks for an authenticated user session, it fails to verify whether user.id has permission to read or edit docName. Any authenticated user can connect to any document's WebSocket channel, receive the entire Yjs CRDT state history, and inject arbitrary state modifications.
